samajh nahi aaya
Ghar se school tak 1 km ka raasta hai, aur beech mein 3 khambe barabar doori par hain. Pehla khamba kahan hai, yeh dhoondhna hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan
Pehla kadam dekho. Ek line kheencho, ghar 0 par aur school 1 par: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki ghar se school tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai.

haan
